morphology.pattern_note: 作为外来人名整词记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。通常写作 Stewart；所列为一种英式读音，个人姓名应尊重本人读法。

senses.zh_definition: 斯图尔特；源于苏格兰的姓氏，也用作名字。具体指谁须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: A surname of Scottish origin, also used as a given name.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang berasal dari Scotland dan juga digunakan sebagai nama diri; rujukannya ditentukan oleh konteks.
senses.nuances: 此处 noun 指专有名词。输入的小写形式不构成一个已核实的普通马来语词，也不能直接理解为 steward 或马来语 pramugara。姓名来源参见 [Stewarts of Balquhidder](https://stewartsofbalquhidder.com/stewart-families/stewart-origins/)；读音变体参见 [Behind the Name](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/stewart)。以下为自然称谓组合，并非固定词汇搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Stewart began as an occupational surname connected with the office of steward, a person entrusted with managing another person's household or estate. In Scotland, the hereditary High Stewards made that office especially prominent. The name later became associated with a royal dynasty, but sharing the surname alone does not establish royal descent. Sources: [Stewart family history](https://stewartsofbalquhidder.com/stewart-families/stewart-origins/), [Dictionaries of the Scots Language](https://dsl.ac.uk/entry/dost/stewart).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Stewart 与 steward“管家”联想：历史上的职务成为姓氏；现代姓名本身不翻译成“管家”。
